channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Kioxia, SanDisk show off the tiny chip which could go in world's first 1 PB SSD
item.description: SanDisk and Koxia have unveiled next-generation QLC 3D flash memory technology, said to increase bit density over the previous generation by 60%

item.title: 'I hope people say I was a good and decent man,' Tim Cook on his post-Apple legacy — and why for him I don't think any other answer was possible
item.description: Tim Cook was asked about his legacy as CEO of Apple, and his answer was more revealing than you might think.

item.title: This designer was tired of being ghosted by employers. Now he’s sending them ‘unhinged’ résumés
item.description: Felix Toohey’s viral ‘Ghosting Busters’ series is opening up a discussion about what we should be willing to do to land our dream jobs. Between companies ghosting job applicants and companies advertising ghost jobs that don’t exist, it can feel harder than ever to find a job.

item.title: 'For pros, there's none better': Samsung’s flagship 9100 Pro SSD is only $10 more than the 990 Pro for the ultimate workstation upgrade
item.description: Torn between the Samsung 9100 Pro and the 990 Pro? If you're a professional user with the right kit, the best pick is only $10 more.

item.title: Thrive’s Joshua Kushner chides Silicon Valley VCs over AI euphoria
item.description: The AI opportunity is huge but "it would also be a grave error in our minds to let excitement weaken our investment discipline," Kushner warns in his first-ever investment letter.

item.title: Tesla says a flying car is coming. BYD already has one that makes sense
item.description: Once again, Elon Musk will try to sell us a prototype that doesn’t make much sense and possibly will never even materialize. Elon Musk is reportedly going to launch a “flying car.” Not a flying taxi like those oversized drones that want to take rich people from Manhattan to JFK laughing at us peasants traveling in regular cabs. Not another old Tesla Roadster mounted atop a Falcon 9. No. This will be a next-generation Tesla Roadster that can fly on its own using cold gas thrusters developed by SpaceX. Like Nick Fury’s flying car....

item.title: First-time homebuyers could soon get a new way to find $35,000 for a down payment
item.description: Lawmakers are proposing a change that would let buyers use money sitting in 529 college savings accounts for their first home. Trump’s new savings accounts for kids just went live last month, but they’re not the only interesting investment change in the mix this year.

item.title: Samsung has new Galaxy headphones in the works
item.description: Strings of code in Samsung's Galaxy Wearable app hint at an upcoming pair of over-ear headphones that could compete with the AirPods Max, SamMobile reports. Samsung's reportedly referring to the headphones as the "Galaxy H1," and SamMobile says they could launch sometime in 2027. That would make these the company's first pair of over-ear headphones […]...

item.title: Upgrade your setup: HP’s Smart Tank 5101 ink tank printer drops to $170 with 2 years of ink
item.description: An ideal step up for hybrid workers and students, we're big fans of the HP ink tank printers we've tested, especially when they have free ink in the box.

item.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content
What we know about the alleged Iranian hacks on US water utilities
item.description: Over the last couple of weeks, hackers have targeted and broken into the systems of several water plants in the United States. Here’s what we know and don’t know about this wave of attacks allegedly carried out by the Iranian government.

item.title: Read-it-later app Pocket shut down — here are the best alternatives
item.description: Pocket users have until October 8, 2025, to export their saved articles and other items, including lists, archives, favorites, notes, and highlights.

item.title: Google must make it easier to install alternative app stores, judge orders
item.description: Google has a week to make it easier to find third-party app stores.

item.title: Cards Against Humanity has a $10 plan to annoy Elon Musk
item.description: After a dispute with SpaceX over its Texas property, the game maker is recruiting fans to help design a monument aimed squarely at the billionaire. Elon Musk does not shy away from bizarre conflict: He dared Mark Zuckerberg to a cage fight that never materialized, publicly feuded with President Trump after a monthslong public friendship, and even challenged Vladimir Putin to “single combat.”...
